Stephens Investment Management Group Llc decreased its stake in Neogen Corp (NEOG) by 3.99% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stephens Investment Management Group Llc sold 29,565 shares as the company’s stock rose 6.02% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 712,117 shares of the in vitro & in vivo diagnostic substances company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $58.54M, down from 741,682 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stephens Investment Management Group Llc who had been investing in Neogen Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.85 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.01% or $0.01 during the last trading session, reaching $74.7. About 176,264 shares traded.
